question: To what kind of person is a certain thing to be given according to this qualification?
premises: A thing is to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: Transmission is prescribed to one who is endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: The object to be given is not named here.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states, to one of resolved mind.
